overview: The board deliberated on dimensional relief requests for two proposed accessory dwelling units (ADUs), approved a use variance for a second single-family home with safety and landscaping conditions, and approved a change of non-conforming use for a new aesthetic spa.

items.title: 1-3 Vassar Street
items.summary: Continued the application of Christian Austin to construct two shed dormers and expand the attic space for a protected ADU to the October 29, 2026 meeting.

items.title: 60 Sturgis Street
items.summary: Approved a use variance to construct a second single-family dwelling on the lot, conditioned upon replacing an existing lead water service line and installing rear and side landscape screening.

items.title: 12 Wellesley Street
items.summary: Continued the application of Christian Austin to construct two shed dormers and expand the attic space for a protected ADU to the October 29, 2026 meeting.

items.title: 583 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a special permit to change the non-conforming use from a real estate office to an aesthetic spa.

items.title: August Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Postponed the approval of the August meeting minutes.
